data.description: Currently Main Street is limited to a 2x5 street. We should add a mechanic that will allow the player to expand into neighbouring streets. When the player 'zooms out' it will expose more streets on a grid system. The grid will not be limited in size. As the player zooms out the grid will keep growing. Each section of the grid will consist of a 2x5 street to the north, east, west and south. With the corner plots shared with each edge.
data.title: Enable Main Street expansion of playing area

data.author: Map
data.comment:
{"type":"comment","text":"**Intake clarifying questions (CG-0MT5Y1X5T001M4S6):**

The current description is high-level — the following questions need answers to build an actionable implementation brief:

**Q1: What triggers the grid expansion?** Is it (a) a player purchase/upgrade action, (b) a milestone trigger (e.g. reach X reputation or complete Y challenges), or (c) automatic as the game progresses (e.g. unlock one new street every N turns)?

**Q2: How does \"zoom\" work visually and mechanically?** Is this a camera zoom that reveals pre-defined streets on a larger 2D grid (like a map), or does the grid itself grow dynamically (e.g. from 1×1 streets to 2×2, 3×3)? Are all streets in a row unlocked together, or individually?

**Q3: What does \"corner plots shared with each edge\" mean for gameplay?** When two streets meet at a corner, does the corner slot count as adjacent to neighbours in both streets? Does it have one card that serves both, or two half-plots? How does this affect synergy and income?"}
